datatype.name: Population
datatype.definition: A non-negative count of people resident in an area.

concept.name: Place
concept.definition: A location in space that can be referred to and contained within another.

concept.name: AdministrativeArea
concept.definition: A government-defined area that may contain smaller administrative areas. Containment is a `part_of` relation (mereology), NOT inheritance: a city is not a *kind of* county.

provenance.note: Concrete subdivisions follow national schemes (e.g. ISO 3166-2).

property.name: residentPopulation
property.definition: People resident directly in this area, excluding its sub-areas.

provenance.note: Per-area values are sourced at L2 (e.g. a national census).

concept.name: Country
concept.definition: A nation state or distinct territory.

provenance.note: Coding only; contested status is handled per ETHICS.md with provenance.

concept.name: County
concept.definition: A first-level administrative subdivision of a country (exact meaning varies by country).

provenance.note: First-level subdivisions; the local term varies by country.

concept.name: City
concept.definition: A populated urban settlement; a leaf administrative area with no sub-areas.

provenance.note: The legal threshold for 'city' varies by jurisdiction.
